feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 September 2026 5:16pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 24 September 2026 at 5:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over Germany, and a deep area of low pressure to the southwest of Iceland bringing a cold front overnight.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, but remaining 4 in the southeast of the area, veering west 3 or 4 in all waters overnight, then backing southwest tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight overnight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain overnight and tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, occasionally increasing 5 Friday evening, then becoming 4 or 5 Friday night, and occasionally increasing 6 in the north of the area for a time. Then increasing 5 or 6 late Saturday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
